consent.title: Cookies & privacy
consent.body: We use only strictly necessary cookies by default. Optional categories load only with your explicit choice — you can change it anytime.
consent.managerBody: Review or change your consent choices. Every decision is recorded as an auditable entry.
consent.noDecisionYet: No decision recorded yet — choose below.
consent.resetHint: Withdrawing shows the consent banner again; optional processing stops immediately.
consent.historyPending: The consent audit trail is being prepared on the server — your local decisions remain effective.
consent.exportBody: Under GDPR Article 20 you can receive the personal data you provided in a portable format. The archive is prepared securely and a download link is delivered to your account email.
consent.exportSubmitted: Request received. We will notify you when the export is ready to download.
consent.exportPendingNotice: The self-service export is being prepared. Until it ships, contact journey4oflife+jolarca.dev@gmail.com — nothing was recorded by this click.
consent.exportError: The request could not be submitted. Please try again.
consent.erasureBody: Under GDPR Article 17 you can request erasure of your personal data. This action cannot be undone.
consent.erasureItem2: Saved addresses and consent records (after the retention window)
consent.erasureItem3: Seller listings and messages you created
consent.retainedItem1: Financial records for statutory accounting periods
consent.retainedItem2: Records needed to defend legal claims until their limitation period ends
consent.erasureConfirmHint: The request is submitted only after exact confirmation.
consent.erasureFollowUp: We will process it within the statutory deadline and confirm by email.
consent.erasurePendingNotice: The self-service erasure portal is being prepared. Until it ships, contact journey4oflife+jolarca.dev@gmail.com — nothing was recorded by this click.
consent.erasureError: The request could not be submitted. Please try again.

funeral.metaDescription: Respectful funeral services across the Baltics.
funeral.heroSubtitle: Connect with trusted funeral homes and memorial services
funeral.heroReassurance: Losing someone is hard. Finding help should not be. Browse funeral homes near you, ask your questions, and take the time you need. There is no obligation at any step.
funeral.expectBody1: First, you tell us a little about what you need. There are no required answers.
funeral.expectBody2: Then a member of our team contacts you, usually within 24 hours. We listen first.
funeral.expectBody3: If you wish, we connect you with a funeral home. You stay in control of every decision.
funeral.directoryIntro: Each home listed here has been checked by our team. Contact them directly, or ask us to help.
funeral.directoryLoadFailed: We could not load the directory right now. Please try again in a moment, or ask us for help.
funeral.directoryEmpty: We have no listings for that search yet. Please contact us and we will help you personally.
funeral.directoryAskHelpIntro: If you would rather speak with a person,
funeral.serviceDesc_burial: Full burial arrangements, from preparing the body to the graveside ceremony.
funeral.serviceDesc_cremation: Cremation services, including urns and remembrance options.
funeral.serviceDesc_memorial: Memorial and farewell ceremonies, planned with your family.
funeral.serviceDesc_monument: Headstones and monuments, restored and placed with care.
funeral.serviceDesc_counseling: Gentle counseling and practical guidance for families in mourning.
funeral.serviceDescGeneric: Our team will gladly explain the details when you contact us.
funeral.consultIntro: We are here to help you through this difficult time. Leave your details and a member of our team will reach out — gently, and without obligation.
funeral.consultIntroProvider: We are here to help you through this difficult time. Leave your details and a member of our team will connect you with {provider}.
